title: Your Future Job: Will AI Be Your Next Co-Worker? What Tata's Chairman Just Said
description: N. Chandrasekaran, Chairman of Tata Sons, recently said that Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) could soon have as many Artificial Intelligence (AI) "agents" as .

faq.a: An AI agent is a computer program designed to perceive its environment, make decisions, and take actions to achieve specific goals, often without constant human intervention.

faq.q: Is TCS already using AI agents?
faq.a: Yes, companies like TCS are already integrating AI into various operations. Mr. Chandrasekaran's statement refers to a future where their presence will be as significant as human employees.

faq.q: Will this affect my job if I don't work in IT?
faq.a: AI is a general-purpose technology, meaning it will impact many industries beyond IT, including manufacturing, healthcare, finance, and customer service. The principles of automation and skill transformation apply broadly.

faq.q: What kind of new jobs will AI create?
faq.a: AI is expected to create roles like AI trainers, AI ethicists, prompt engineers, AI system managers, data scientists, and specialists in human-AI collaboration.

faq.q: What should I do to prepare for these changes?
faq.a: Focus on developing "soft skills" like creativity, critical thinking, and emotional intelligence, alongside "hard skills" in data analysis, AI tools, and digital literacy. Continuous learning and adaptability will be key.
